user_stories.title: Create CodeExecuteTool with sandboxed execution

user_stories.title: Implement context.score_relevance() function
acceptance_criteria: Takes text and list of keywords as parameters
Returns float score (higher = more relevant)

Exact word matches (word boundary) have weight 2.0
Partial matches (substring) have weight 0.5
Scoring is case-insensitive
Multiple occurrences of same keyword are cumulative
Multiple keywords are cumulative
user_stories.notes: Simple scoring algorithm. No complex NLP needed. Weighted matching works well.

Filters out words shorter than 3 characters
Keeps technical terms and relevant nouns
Uses regex to extract words (\b[a-zA-Z]{3,}\b)
user_stories.notes: Simple keyword extraction. No NLP library needed. Good enough for context curation.
